description: This file defines a specialized configuration class for interacting with the XAI API within the litellm framework. It extends the OpenAIGPTConfig class to customize API request parameters, handle API-specific response transformations, and include XAI-specific logic such as support checks and usage tracking.

classes.name: XAIChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for interacting with the XAI API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig to include XAI-specific parameter support, request transformation, and response handling.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a string identifier for the custom LLM provider, set to "xai".

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Returns the API base URL and API key, fetching secrets if not provided.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported based on the model, including support for stop tokens, frequency penalty, and reasoning.

methods.name: bool _supports_stop_reason(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model supports stop reasons, specifically identifying unsupported models.

methods.name: bool _supports_frequency_penalty(self, model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the model supports the 'frequency_penalty' parameter.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool = False, )
methods.description: Maps custom parameter names to supported OpenAI parameters for request configuration.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares and transforms the request payload, stripping 'name' from messages and delegating to the superclass for further processing.

methods.name: None _fix_choice_finish_reason_for_tool_calls(choice: Choices)
methods.description: Adjusts the finish_reason for choices with tool_calls when the API returns an empty string.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response, fixing finish_reason issues, and extracting web search usage data for tracking.

methods.name: None _enhance_usage_with_xai_web_search_fields( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Extracts num_sources_used from the raw response JSON and updates the usage object accordingly.
